leaders.name: Sanne de Vries
leaders.title: Co-founder & Chief Executive Officer
leaders.bio: Ran the recruitment agency where the first matching tool was built. Still sits in on customer hiring debriefs every month.

leaders.name: Arjun Rao
leaders.title: Co-founder & Chief Technology Officer
leaders.bio: Wrote the original matching engine and the rule that every score must carry its reasons.

leaders.name: Maya Okonkwo
leaders.title: Chief Product Officer
leaders.bio: A former head of talent acquisition who joined as a customer and stayed to run the roadmap.

leaders.name: Lucas Bennett
leaders.title: Chief Revenue Officer
leaders.bio: Leads sales and partnerships from Austin, with a team that demos on your real requisitions.

leaders.name: Priya Iyer
leaders.title: VP Customer Success
leaders.bio: Built the onboarding programme that gets most teams live in under two weeks.

leaders.name: Elena Hoffmann
leaders.title: Chief Trust Officer
leaders.bio: Privacy lawyer by training. Signs off the quarterly bias audits and publishes them to customers.

leadershipPrinciples.title: One named owner
leadershipPrinciples.body: Every customer commitment, from uptime to bias audits, has a single leader accountable for it.

leadershipPrinciples.title: Close to customers
leadershipPrinciples.body: Each leader spends time with hiring teams every month, in live debriefs rather than slide reviews.

leadershipPrinciples.title: Published, not promised
leadershipPrinciples.body: Audit results, uptime and roadmap changes are shared with customers as they happen.
